decision: At three real targets, one canonical source graph expresses and rebuilds the common/specific boundary correctly, and a changed common source makes all three existing targets stale before one rebuild restores currentness. Whole-module delivery is therefore proven at this pressure, while the frozen minimal-read condition is not met for the historical source granularity and prose-relative total cost remains unproven. Do not add a fourth target or inverse impact because neither can reduce the observed fixed reads and source-to-consumer tracing did not fail.
